opening.argument: The video openly frames the call as a test of a scammer, then closes by telling viewers not to give people like this their money. The caller claims infections in a Facebook network, directs a support-connection download and asks for card details; those steps are presented as the conduct being exposed, not as advice for viewers to follow. The speaker also says the name given to the caller was fake, reinforcing the demonstrative nature of the exchange. The request to like the video is ordinary engagement, not financial participation. Nothing in this record establishes that viewers paid, lost money or followed the caller's directions.
